#Titanoboa #JohnCena #arnoldschwarzenegger 

Watch this Titanoboa 2027 concept trailer and enter a lost world where the Amazon’s deadliest secret has finally awakened.

This fan-made What If concept features John Cena as Commander Marcus Rourke, Amanda Seyfried as evolutionary biologist Dr. Elena Voss, and Arnold Schwarzenegger as industrialist Viktor Krane.
A rescue expedition descends into a prehistoric basin filled with flooded ruins, ancient ecosystems, and a colossal serpent believed to have vanished millions of years ago.
When the team discovers that Krane stole one of Titanoboa’s eggs, their mission becomes a desperate fight to survive and return it before the hidden world collapses around them.
The storyboard and visuals were personally created by me to imagine a large-scale creature adventure filled with jungle exploration, survival tension, and cinematic action.

Titanoboa is not simply hunting the expedition for food, but defending its nest from the humans who invaded its territory and tried to turn it into a weapon.
The concept trailer combines armored vehicle chases, flooded temples, geothermal destruction, prehistoric creatures, and an intense confrontation between Krane and the scarred giant serpent.
John Cena’s Marcus must protect the survivors, while Amanda Seyfried’s Elena risks everything to return the stolen egg and prove that the creature is acting to protect its offspring.
Watch until the final reveal as an enormous shadow moves beneath the Amazon River, suggesting that Titanoboa was never the only giant serpent still alive.

snippet.title: The Search For The Leviathan
snippet.description:
In the last few months, hundreds of reports have appeared all over the internet, all claiming to see the same thing in their Minecraft oceans - a sea monster called The Leviathan. But is it just a massive hoax, or is there something more to it? I'm going to find out.

Voice of Hummer:  @schpoody 
Voice of Arronax:  @jumperwho 

ORIGINAL MUSIC BY: Ben Bracey (@benbraceymusic on instagram)
https://soundcloud.com/benbraceymusic/sets/hunting-the-leviathan-original

Download all the builds in this video for $5 on both Java and Bedrock!!: https://maps.wifies.net/products/the-leviathan  



DO NOT READ BELOW FOR SPOILERS:


Well well well here we are again. I think this video is interesting in that the first 12 minutes can't prepare you for the remaining hour; as in the pacing is very different/the style totally shifts. So we'll see how that goes...

I'm really fond of the ending I like how that last 10 minutes turned out. That final scene with hummer was inspired by one of my favorite short stories, "Hell is the Absence of God" by Ted Chiang. There are definitely some parts of the video that I think could be a little better like maybe the dialogue is a bit dragged but overall I'm pretty satisfied with the majority of the video. 

Thematically, I think you might be able to tell the kind of story I was playing around with, but I was also hugely inspired by the Lochness Monster. Probably some of my favorite parts of research for this video was reading the Lochness Monster wiki and learning more about the kind of theories/tools people use to look for it. The F3 scene on hummer's boat was inspired by all the sonar and stuff people use to check for Nessie.

Also just a MASSIVE shoutout to schpood for all the hours and care he poured into this video. I'm so thankful for the enthusiasm and feedback he gave and the video would be so much worse without him. And thank you to my discord server members for making (almost) all of the fake reports you see in this video. They were super creative and did a way better job than I could have.

➤➤ Discord: https://discord.gg/zAWUuWb

All screenshots/reddit posts/websites in this video do NOT exist and were made for the sake of the video. If any link redirects to an actual website - that is coincidental and do not treat it as "official";  it was just put in the video make the world feel more real. 

This is NOT series called Minecraft VVSauce where I explore random features of Minecraft. Not Secret Minecraft things or Minecraft lore (like Game Theory) or Escape Rooms, but an ARG that isn't an ARG but it's actually unfiction - a genre pretending to be real that isn't real but we all pretend to be real. This is the search for the leviathan. I hope you enjoy

snippet.title: Jason Mraz | I'm Yours | Lyrics Video
snippet.description:
Jason Mraz | I'm Yours | Lyrics Video
#JasonMraz #ImYours #Lyrics

[Verse 1]
Well, you done done me in, you bet I felt it
I tried to be chill, but you're so hot that I melted
I fell right through the cracks
Now I'm trying to get back
Before the cool done run out, I'll be giving it my bestest
And nothing's gonna stop me but divine intervention
I reckon it's again my turn
To win some or learn some

[Chorus]
But I won't hesitate no more, no more
It cannot wait, I'm yours

[Post-Chorus]
Mm, mm

[Verse 2]
Well, open up your mind and see like me
Open up your plans and, damn, you're free
Look into your heart and you'll find
Love, love, love, love
Listen to the music of the moment, people dance and sing
We're just one big family
And it's our godforsaken right to be
Loved, loved, loved, loved, loved

[Chorus]
So I won't hesitate no more, no more
It cannot wait, I'm sure
There's no need to complicate, our time is short
This is our fate, I'm yours

[Bridge]
Do you want to? Come on
Scooch on over closer, dear
And I will nibble your ear
Woah, oh-oh
Woah, oh, oh, oh
Oh-oh-oh-oh-oh, ah-ha
Mhm

[Verse 3]
I've been spending way too long checking my tongue in the mirror
And bending over backwards just to try to see it clearer
But my breath fogged up the glass
And so I drew a new face and I laughed
I guess what I be saying is there ain't no better reason
To rid yourself of vanities and just go with the seasons
It's what we aim to do
Our name is our virtue

[Chorus]
But I won't hesitate no more, no more
It cannot wait, I'm yours

[Outro]
Well, open up your mind and see like me (I won't hesitate)
Open up your plans and, damn, you're free (No more, no more)
Look into your heart and you'll find that (It cannot wait)
The sky is yours (I'm sure)
So please don't, please don't, please don't (No need to complicate)
There's no need to complicate (Our time is short)
'Cause our time is short (This is our fate)
This, oh, this, oh, this is our fate
I'm yours, ah
Oh, I'm yours
Oh, oh, I'm yours
Oh, woah
Baby, do believe I'm yours
You best believe, you best believe I'm yours
Mhm, mhm
